Run is not a synonym of get in this sense.
Get is common in both speech and writing; calling it a spoken choice is too restrictive.

verdicts.quote: "become is the neutral word in writing"
verdicts.reason: Become is common in writing, but it is not simply the neutral word; it is less usual than get with many everyday adjectives.
The sense also regularly takes an object plus an adverb, as in get someone home or get something upstairs.

verdicts.quote: "or make a thing do what you want"
verdicts.reason: Thing is too vague here; this construction applies to machines and other objects, and the wording is not precise.
Get meaning understand can occur in progressive forms, especially with a developing understanding, as in I am getting it now.
A separate sense should include typical combinations such as get someone or get a thief.

verdicts.quote: "Only in the present perfect form have got"
verdicts.reason: Have got is not a present perfect form in this meaning; it is a present-tense idiomatic form of have.
This restriction is unnecessary and potentially misleading because the construction itself is fixed as have got rather than a normal progressive use of get.

verdicts.quote: "We've got to leave before the traffic gets bad."
verdicts.reason: This illustrates have got to meaning must, a distinct construction from the possession sense.
Have got to meaning must is a distinct construction and should not be listed as a collocation of the possession sense.

verdicts.quote: "Have got is present only: for the past use had."
verdicts.reason: This is broadly useful but needs to distinguish the possession construction from the ordinary present perfect have got meaning have received.
The definition is phrased as an imperative addressed to the reader rather than as a definition of the expression.

verdicts.quote: "Become is the neutral word and the usual one in writing"
verdicts.reason: Become is more formal and more common in writing than get, but it is not generally the neutral word.

verdicts.quote: "many teachers and editors think it is too vague for careful writing"
verdicts.reason: This overstates a prescriptive view; get is acceptable in careful writing when it is precise enough.

verdicts.quote: "that other languages express with many different verbs"
verdicts.reason: Adaptation notes must be language-neutral and must not make claims about other languages.
The common modal construction have got to must be given its own sense or construction entry rather than embedded in the possession sense.
